question: I need you to look into the actor collaborations and tell me how many actors have made more films with Yash Chopra than with any other director. This will help us understand his influence on the industry better.
sql:
-- Final count of actors who made more films with Yash Chopra than with any other director
WITH yc_actors AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(c.PID) as actor_pid
    FROM M_Cast c
    JOIN M_Director d ON c.MID = d.MID
    WHERE d.PID = 'nm0007181'
    AND TRIM(c.PID) != 'nm0007181'
),
actor_yc_count AS (
    SELECT yc.actor_pid, COUNT(DISTINCT c.MID) as yc_count
    FROM yc_actors yc
    JOIN M_Cast c ON yc.actor_pid = TRIM(c.PID)
    JOIN M_Director d ON c.MID = d.MID
    WHERE d.PID = 'nm0007181'
    GROUP BY yc.actor_pid
),
actor_other_max AS (
    SELECT yc.actor_pid, MAX(cnt) as max_other_count
    FROM yc_actors yc
    JOIN (
        SELECT TRIM(c.PID) as actor_pid, d.PID as director_pid, COUNT(DISTINCT c.MID) as cnt
        FROM M_Cast c
        JOIN M_Director d ON c.MID = d.MID
        WHERE d.PID != 'nm0007181'
        GROUP BY TRIM(c.PID), d.PID
    ) other ON yc.actor_pid = other.actor_pid
    GROUP BY yc.actor_pid
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as actor_count
FROM actor_yc_count a
LEFT JOIN actor_other_max m ON a.actor_pid = m.actor_pid
WHERE a.yc_count > COALESCE(m.max_other_count, 0)

WITH yc_films AS (

    FROM M_Cast c

    SELECT actor_pid, COUNT(*) as yc_count
    FROM yc_films

    SELECT yc.actor_pid, d.PID as director_pid, COUNT(DISTINCT yc.movie_id) as other_count
    FROM yc_films yc
    JOIN M_Cast c ON yc.actor_pid = c.PID AND yc.movie_id != c.MID
    JOIN M_Director d ON c.MID = d.MID

    GROUP BY yc.actor_pid, d.PID
)
SELECT a.actor_pid, a.yc_count, MAX(o.other_count) as max_other_count
FROM actor_yc_count a
LEFT JOIN actor_other_counts o ON a.actor_pid = o.actor_pid
GROUP BY a.actor_pid, a.yc_count
HAVING a.yc_count > COALESCE(MAX(o.other_count), 0)
ORDER BY a.yc_count DESC
